style_image_url.description: URL of the style reference image — the artistic style, material, lighting and color of this image are transferred onto the content image.

enable_safety_checker.description: If set to true, the safety checker will be enabled.

lightning_lora_scale.description: Strength of the Lightning LoRA. 1.0 matches the reference implementation; lower values apply the style more subtly.

seed.description: The same seed and the same inputs given to the same version of the model will output the same image every time.

use_style_description.description: If true, describe the style image with a VLM and add the description to the prompt.

use_content_description.description: If true, describe the content image with a VLM and add the description to the prompt.

acceleration.description: Acceleration level for image generation. 'none' (the default) honors the requested num_inference_steps, so the default 4-step Lightning configuration runs in 4 steps. 'regular' engages the downstream accelerated path, which runs a fixed 10 steps regardless of num_inference_steps.

height.description: The height of the generated image.

width.description: The width of the generated image.

image_size.description: The size of the generated image. If not provided, the size of the content image is used.

sync_mode.description: If `True`, the media will be returned as a data URI and the output data won't be available in the request history.

num_inference_steps.description: The number of inference steps to perform.

content_image_url.description: URL of the content image — the image whose subject and structure are preserved while the style is applied.

use_lightning_lora.description: If true, use the Lightning LoRA in addition to the default LoRA.

num_images.description: The number of images to generate.

guidance_scale.description: The CFG (Classifier Free Guidance) scale is a measure of how close you want the model to stick to your prompt.

negative_prompt.description: The negative prompt for the generation.

output_format.description: The format of the generated image.

lora_scale.description: Strength of the TeleStyleV2 style adapter. 1.0 matches the reference implementation; lower values apply the style more subtly.
